summary: Volaris (NYSE: VLRS) filed a 6-K on June 15, 2026, to disclose the resignation of director Andrew Broderick, effective immediately, for a new professional challenge. This is a routine board departure reported via press release; no forced or abrupt change is indicated. The filing includes a brief acknowledgment and gratitude but does not name any replacement or structural governance impact. For non-US filers, Form 6-K is the equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K. With no other special-situation elements (e.g., M&A, tender, activist campaign), the event falls under Management Changes as a director resignation. Watch for subsequent filings if a successor is appointed or if this signals broader board shifts.
